original_submission.content:
import shutil
import os

source_file = 'storage/progressor/transgen_strategies/gen4_final_strategies.json'
# I'll need to know the name of the directory my script just created.
# Based on my AOS logic, it should be exp_003_...
# This is a procedural weakness. For now, I'll hardcode the most likely path.
# I will create a task to improve this later.
destination_dir = 'storage/telos/experiments/exp_003_reproduction_of_progressor_i_s_gen_5_scalability'
os.makedirs(destination_dir, exist_ok=True)
destination_file = os.path.join(destination_dir, 'gen4_final_strategies.json')

print(f"Copying {source_file} to {destination_file}...")
shutil.copyfile(source_file, destination_file)
print("Copy complete.")
